meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证并规划本地基因组间隔工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果处理基因组数据并需要验证BED文件
copy.tagline_en: Validate and plan local genomic-interval workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with genomic data and need to validate BED files

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 能使用 geniml 工具处理 BED 格式的基因组区间数据：训练区域嵌入（Region2Vec）、分析单细胞 ATAC-seq（scEmbed）、构建共识峰（universe）、以及进行元数据关联搜索（BEDspace）。
howto.when: 当用户询问或需要处理基因组区间数据（BED 文件）的机器学习任务时触发，例如区域嵌入、单细胞染色质可及性分析或共识峰构建。

say.text: 帮我用 Region2Vec 训练一批 BED 文件的嵌入。
用 scEmbed 分析这个 scATAC-seq 数据并聚类。
say.note: 会加载 AnnData 并运行 scEmbed 流程。

say.text: 构建一个覆盖所有 BED 文件的共识峰集合。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the geniml tool to handle BED-format genomic interval data: train region embeddings (Region2Vec), analyze single-cell ATAC-seq (scEmbed), build consensus peaks (universe), and perform metadata-aware searches (BEDspace).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about or needs machine learning tasks on genomic interval data (BED files), such as region embedding, single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis, or consensus peak building.

say_en.text: Train Region2Vec embeddings on a set of BED files.
Analyze this scATAC-seq data with scEmbed and cluster cells.
say_en.note: Loads AnnData and runs scEmbed pipeline.

say_en.text: Build a consensus peak set from all BED files.
say_en.note: Uses CC or CCF method to generate universe.bed.
